clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Teldrassil, Bloodfeather harpies wear crude leather belts as they crowd the Oracle Glade. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak collects them as proof that the nearby nests have been cleared.

Bloodfeather harpies have built aggressive nests in the boughs around the Oracle Glade. Their presence threatens the ancient Oracle Tree and blocks travel through northern Teldrassil. After the flock ambushed and killed a runner carrying reports to Darnassus, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak called on travelers to strike at the nests. The belts taken from fallen harpies show that their numbers are being culled and the paths are being secured, so messages can reach the capital again.
